title: Is it true that the sum of the k largest Laplacian eigenvalues of a graph with m edges is at most k(k+1)/2+m
exact_target: Is the sum of the largest k Laplacian eigenvalues always at most the number of edges plus k(k+1)/2?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 3100031 (AMR-030-0031). CC BY 4.0.
Joshua N. Cooper, Constraints on Brouwer's Laplacian Spectrum Conjecture (2020), section 1, equation (1), pp. 1--2.
